cases.description: WDA identity uses strict stdout JSON while retaining bounded stderr and original child outcomes
surfaces: iOS scene acceptance coordinator; no native/UI behavior claim
cases.setup: Real Runner child processes in task temporary directories; exact collect_identity with synthetic session, WDA plist/binary and native argv translated only at Popen to controlled small children. No installed native tool invocation.
cases.action: Valid stdout JSON plus destination warnings on stderr through collect_identity; invalid stdout prefix or JSON only on stderr; original exit0/7; timeout; output cap from stderr or combined stdout+stderr; default combined text remains unchanged.
cases.expected: Identity reads strict stdout and retains target deployment, session/PID/actual-launch/binary SHA. Both complete stream files and command metadata remain evidence. Malformed/absent stdout or nonzero child cannot pass. Split capture has the same timeout and aggregate byte budget as the original command; output/timeout/fault failures preserve acquired original exit and remain red. Default commands preserve codesign stderr behavior. Tests must fail against09fe or omitted split call; no prefix-stripping acceptance. These are local execution controls, not app/WDA/device validation.
